name: @pipeworx/mcp-cdec-ca

tools.name: daily_data
tools.description: Daily data for (station, sensor). CDEC's -9999 missing marker is returned as value: null with missing: true, and the response counts the gaps.

tools.name: hourly_data
tools.description: Hourly data for (station, sensor). CDEC's -9999 missing marker is returned as value: null with missing: true, and the response counts the gaps.

tools.name: event_data
tools.description: Event-based irregular readings for (station, sensor). CDEC's -9999 missing marker is returned as value: null with missing: true.

tools.name: latest
tools.description: Most recent REAL reading for (station, sensor), looking back three days. CDEC writes -9999 into slots it has no reading for and the current day's trailing hours are routinely unwritten, so this skips those and reports how many missing slots it skipped rather than returning the marker as a number.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cdec-ca forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cdec-ca pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
